streaming_input.text: Address the after-hours instruction first. It tells people to wait for an emailed reply
even during an attempt in progress, contradicting the approved emergency card's direction to
call 911 or go to an emergency department immediately.
Move away from immediate hazards if you can do so safely, and go to a
trusted person who can stay nearby. If self-harm has begun or is likely
within minutes, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department;
if you cannot call, ask someone nearby to call. If there is no immediate
danger, call or text 988 for crisis counseling.
